user_query: gmail entries in any workspace about a flights airlines in any workspace koii or trass

intent.goal: Find email entries about flights/airlines in both koii and trass workspaces

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.body_snippet
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('koii', 'trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%flight%' OR
    g.subject LIKE '%airline%' OR
    g.body_snippet LIKE '%flight%' OR
    g.body_snippet LIKE '%airline%' OR
    g.message_content LIKE '%flight%' OR
    g.message_content LIKE '%airline%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
